domestic_evidence: Company website https://www.metrotyres.com/ states: "10k+ Dealers across the country", "50+ Branches across the country", "07 State-of-the-art manufacturing units", "USD 140 Million conglomerate", "Presence in 53+ Countries", "India's No 1 Exporter of bicycle tyres and tubes". These are self-declared marketing figures only. No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, or annual-report domestic/export revenue split could be retrieved: tofler.in and zaubacorp.com both returned HTTP 403 Forbidden, and web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) during this session. Domestic supply therefore remains declared, not confirmed.
note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs records with B/L numbers, destination and HS code — HS 40115090 (bicycle tyres) matches the declared HS family 401150; declared 401320/401390 (inner tubes / other) not observed in the visible rows. Note the direction: the visible rows show Metro Tyres as the Indian shipper/consignor on the ICD Sahnewal (Ludhiana) and ICD Kilaraipur lanes to Hamburg, i.e. genuine outbound export shipments, not imports. Domestic: no verifiable GST turnover, tender or contract record obtained — only website claims, so classified declared_only. Revenue and export volume figures: null (not public in accessible sources; the 'USD 140 Million conglomerate' figure is an unverified self-declaration and is not used as revenue). No rejection grounds: entity is active and shipping as of 2026-02-21.
